card.name: Words linking numbers in dose ranges
card.fires_on: The word or space right after a dose amount, where a range or limit continues, such as 'to' after '1 mg/kg' or the space after 'no more than'. Seen in intravenous dosing and concentration text.

modes.label: Range word after dose
modes.description: The word 'to' between two dose amounts in a range.
modes.example: intravenous administration in the dose range of 1 mg/kg<< to>> 8 mg/kg. No reports involved

modes.label: Space before a concentration
modes.description: The gap after 'no more than' just before a concentration number.
modes.example: Concentrations of no more than<< >>5 mg/mL and rates of no more
